title.description: Unique dataset identifier in ERDDAP e.g., Dominion Wave Buoy, Timeseries Data
examples: South Fork Wind SFW01, Timeseries Data

acknowledgement.description: Acknowlegment of financial supporting entities or award numbers
examples: This dataset is part of a MetOcean Cyberinfrastructure supported by the Integrated Ocean Observing System (IOOS) to streamline integration of data from offshore operations.

comment.description: Used to describe the buoy/platform and contributor
examples: South Fork Wind Lidar buoy developed and deployed by Woods Hole Group

contributor_name.description: Contributor refers to individuals or institutions that contributed to creation of the data. We use for platform deployment/data provider entity

creator_country.description: Creator refers to owner/operator of platform, used here for owner/operator of deployed platform

creator_name.description: Name of creator entity e.g., Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind or Dominion Energy

examples: South Fork Wind - a partnership between Ørsted and Global Infrastructure Partners

infoURL.description: Best website for information about program

summary.description: Basic summary of dataset - location, platform, variables collected
examples: This dataset contains observations to support further understanding of metocean conditions off the coast of New York, Rhode Island and Southeastern Massachusetts. Data is collected from a floating lidar buoy and the dataset includes  measurements of sea temperature (surface and sea floor), current speed, current direction, wave height, wave direction, and wave period, air temperature, atmospheric pressure, relative humidity, visibility, surface wind speed,  surface wind direction, and surface wind gust.

Instrument.description: Instruments used, varies by variable-  see DP metadata - use at attribute level as component (with each variable) or global (separate by comma)
examples: Campbell Scientific MetSENS 500, Campbell Scientific CS120 Visibility Sensor, Garmin GPS16X-HVS, Seaview SVS-603b, Nortek Aquadopp Profiler Z-Cell 600kHz
